value.rationale: The 29-dimensional Betti number does not encode its S7-module; the complete character finds exactly one invariant line and two inequivalent conjugate 14-dimensional constituents. This is a structural canonical group action on a first nontrivial Kneser triple complex and addresses the current literature impetus to understand degree-six classes. The finite size follows the natural seven-point case, not an arbitrary unmotivated parameter slice.
